Passport Renewal (Re-issue)

State / UT: Uttarakhand
Date generated: 16 Nov 2026
Verified: 2026-11-14T00:00:00.000Z

Step-by-step procedure to re-issue an expired or expiring Indian passport online through the official Passport Seva portal. Verified fees (₹1,500 normal, ₹3,500 tatkaal) and document rules.

Required Documents Checklist (7 Items)

Recent Passport-Sized Photograph (For POPSK / Minors)(Optional) • 2 identical physical color prints

Required when visiting a Post Office Passport Seva Kendra (POPSK) or uploading photos for minor applicants. Must strictly follow International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) biometric photo standards.

Original Old Passport(Mandatory) • Original required for physical cancellation

Existing physical passport book in original condition. The passport will be cancelled and returned to the applicant.

Self-Attested Photocopy of Old Passport(Mandatory) • 1 self-attested set

Clear photocopies of the first two pages (bio-data), last two pages (address), ECR/Non-ECR page, and any observation page.

Proof of Current Address(Conditional) • Original + 1 self-attested photocopy

Required if current residential address differs from the address printed on the old passport. Accepted proofs: Aadhaar Card, Electricity Bill (not older than 3 months), Water Bill, Bank Passbook with photo, or registered rent agreement.

Proof of Non-ECR Category (10th Marksheet or Degree Certificate)(Conditional) • Original + 1 self-attested photocopy

Educational certificate showing completion of 10th standard (Matriculation) or higher qualification to claim Emigration Check Not Required status.

Marriage Certificate / Spouse Proof(Conditional) • Original + 1 self-attested photocopy

Required only if adding spouse name for the first time or requesting surname change after marriage.

Annexure E / Tatkaal Verification Proof(Conditional) • Original signed printout

Standard self-declaration in format Annexure E required specifically for expedited Tatkaal passport processing.

Procedure Steps (Compact Overview)

  1. 1.
    Register or Log In to Official Passport Seva Portal[Official Passport Seva Portal (passportindia.gov.in)]

    Visit passportindia.gov.in and select your Passport Office based on your current city. Register a new account or log in with existing credentials.

  2. 2.
    Select 'Apply for Fresh Passport / Re-issue of Passport'[Online Application Dashboard]

    Click 'Apply for Fresh Passport / Re-issue of Passport'. Select 'Re-issue', choose your reason, and pick booklet size (36 or 60 pages) and scheme.

  3. 3.
    Fill the Online Application Form Details[Online Form (Form 1)]

    Enter your applicant details, family details (father, mother, spouse), current residential address, emergency contact, and existing passport number, issue date, and expiry date. Provide details of two local references residing in your neighbourhood.

  4. 4.
    Pay Government Statutory Fee Online[Integrated SBI ePay Gateway]

    Click 'Pay and Schedule Appointment'. Pay ₹1,500 (36 pages) or ₹2,000 (60 pages) online via Net Banking, Card, or UPI. Payment is mandatory to book a slot.

  5. 5.
    Schedule Appointment at Nearest PSK or POPSK[Online Slot Booking System]

    Select your nearest Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) or Post Office Passport Seva Kendra (POPSK) and choose an available date and time slot. Print or download the Application Receipt showing your ARN and appointment batch time.

  6. 6.
    Visit the PSK with Original Documents[Designated Passport Seva Kendra (Physical Visit)]

    Arrive 15 minutes before your appointment time. You will visit Counter A for biometrics, Counter B for document verification, and Counter C for approval.

  7. 7.
    Undergo Local Police Verification[Applicant Residence / Local Police Station]

    If current address has changed, local police station conducts in-person physical address verification. The police officer visits your residence to check original address proof and verify your two local references.

  8. 8.
    Receive Renewed Passport via Speed Post[Delivered to Current Residential Address]

    Once police verification report (PVR) is cleared, your passport is printed at the India Security Press and dispatched via India Post Speed Post. You will receive an SMS with the Speed Post tracking consignment number.

Step-by-Step Procedure

Follow these sequential steps from online registration to final counter collection.

1

Register or Log In to Official Passport Seva Portal

Official Passport Seva Portal (passportindia.gov.in)5 minutes

Visit passportindia.gov.in and select your Passport Office based on your current city. Register a new account or log in with existing credentials.

Official Domain Warning

Only apply on passportindia.gov.in. Never use unauthorized commercial websites that mimic the portal and charge illegitimate consulting fees.
Open Official Passport Seva Portal
2

Select 'Apply for Fresh Passport / Re-issue of Passport'

Online Application Dashboard5 minutes

Click 'Apply for Fresh Passport / Re-issue of Passport'. Select 'Re-issue', choose your reason, and pick booklet size (36 or 60 pages) and scheme.

3

Fill the Online Application Form Details

Online Form (Form 1)20 minutes

Enter your applicant details, family details (father, mother, spouse), current residential address, emergency contact, and existing passport number, issue date, and expiry date. Provide details of two local references residing in your neighbourhood.

Non-ECR Category Eligibility

If you passed 10th standard or hold a degree, select Non-ECR. This avoids emigration check restrictions when travelling overseas.
4

Pay Government Statutory Fee Online

Integrated SBI ePay Gateway5 minutes

Click 'Pay and Schedule Appointment'. Pay ₹1,500 (36 pages) or ₹2,000 (60 pages) online via Net Banking, Card, or UPI. Payment is mandatory to book a slot.

5

Schedule Appointment at Nearest PSK or POPSK

Online Slot Booking System5 minutes

Select your nearest Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) or Post Office Passport Seva Kendra (POPSK) and choose an available date and time slot. Print or download the Application Receipt showing your ARN and appointment batch time.

SMS on Mobile Is Valid

Carrying an SMS appointment confirmation on your mobile phone with ARN is officially accepted at the PSK entrance gate in lieu of a paper printout.
6

Visit the PSK with Original Documents

Designated Passport Seva Kendra (Physical Visit)45-90 minutes

Arrive 15 minutes before your appointment time. You will visit Counter A for biometrics, Counter B for document verification, and Counter C for approval.

7

Undergo Local Police Verification

Applicant Residence / Local Police Station3-7 working days

If current address has changed, local police station conducts in-person physical address verification. The police officer visits your residence to check original address proof and verify your two local references.

8

Receive Renewed Passport via Speed Post

Delivered to Current Residential Address2-4 working days after printing

Once police verification report (PVR) is cleared, your passport is printed at the India Security Press and dispatched via India Post Speed Post. You will receive an SMS with the Speed Post tracking consignment number.

Old Passport Retention

Your old passport will be physically cancelled by the PSK officer (corners clipped) and handed back to you at Counter C. Any valid unexpired visas inside remain legally valid.

What to Do After Submission: Status Tracking & Collection

Once you submit your application and biometric verification is complete:

  • Keep the Acknowledgement Slip: Safely note your Application Number or SMS reference to track status on the official portal.
  • Delivery via Speed Post: Physical cards or renewed booklets are dispatched to your registered address via India Post Speed Post with tracking.
  • Digital Download (DigiLocker / mParivahan): Legally valid digital documents become available on DigiLocker immediately upon counter approval under IT Act Rule 9A.

Why Applications Get Rejected

Review these top 6 counter rejection triggers before visiting the office.

Common Mistakes

Address Mismatch Between Document Proof and Application

Rejection Risk #1

Entering an address in the form that does not match your proof document will cause verification rejection. Always use an exact matching address document.

How to avoid: Ensure the current address typed into the form matches character-by-character with the utility bill or Aadhaar card submitted.

Unclear or Missing Pages in Old Passport Photocopy

Rejection Risk #2

Failing to photocopy both the first two pages and the last two pages, or submitting illegible blurred copies.

How to avoid: Make clear, legible photocopies of pages 1, 2, 35, and 36, and self-attest each sheet with your signature.

Failed Police Verification Due to Absence from Residence

Rejection Risk #3

When the local beat police officer visits your residence and neighbours report that you do not reside there or you cannot be contacted.

How to avoid: Provide active mobile numbers and ensure your two neighbourhood references are aware and available to verify your physical residence.

Applying Under Tatkaal Without Meeting Eligibility Criteria

Rejection Risk #4

applications where the applicant has had major name changes, or whose previous passport was damaged or lost.

How to avoid: Check the official eligibility checklist on Passport Seva before choosing the ; otherwise apply under Normal.

Undisclosed Criminal Proceedings or Pending Court Cases

Rejection Risk #5

Suppressing information regarding pending FIRs or criminal court summons violates Section 12 of the Passports Act 1967.

How to avoid: Always disclose pending matters and obtain an explicit () or court order permitting passport re-issue.

Failure to Attend Rescheduled Appointments within 1 Year

Rejection Risk #6

Missing scheduled appointment dates without attending a PSK within the 1-year application fee validity window leads to fee forfeiture.

How to avoid: Reschedule your appointment online if unable to attend. You are permitted up to 3 appointment reschedules within 12 months from payment date.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common citizen doubts answered according to official Ministry circulars.

8 Answers

You can apply up to 1 year before your passport expires. We recommend applying 6 to 9 months before expiry because many countries require 6 months validity.

Your valid visas remain completely valid! The passport officer will only cancel the passport booklet itself by punching holes in the corners, leaving intact any pages containing active visas. When travelling abroad, simply carry both your new passport and the old cancelled passport containing the valid visa.

Not always. If you apply within 3 years of expiry with no address change, police verification is usually waived or done post-issuance. If your address changed, pre-verification is required.

Yes! Tatkaal renewal is available for urgent travel needs with an additional fee of ₹2,000. Tatkaal passports are dispatched within 1 to 3 working days from the date of application at the PSK. However, Tatkaal is not permitted if the passport has been expired for more than 3 years, lost, damaged, or if major name changes are requested.

If your passport expired more than 3 years ago, renewal is still permitted but requires mandatory pre-issuance police verification. You will also be asked to provide an explanation letter stating the reason for late renewal.

In the online application form, select 'Add/Change Spouse Name' and enter your spouse's name. You must carry your Marriage Certificate or an unexpired passport of your spouse showing your name as spouse.

For adults and children above 4 years of age, physical photos are NOT required. Your digital photograph and biometric fingerprints are captured live at Counter A inside the PSK. Only for infants and children under 4 years of age, parents must carry one recent passport-size color photograph with a plain white background.

You can track your application online on passportindia.gov.in using your 15-digit File Number / ARN. Once dispatched, an India Post Speed Post tracking number (Consignment Number) will be sent via SMS and displayed on the status page.

Before You Leave for Passport Seva Kendra

5 final physical checks before heading out for your PSK slot

Check #1

Original Old Passport & Aadhaar

Carry physical original expired/expiring passport and original Aadhaar card for Biometric Counter A verification.

Check #2

2 Self-Attested Photocopy Sets

First 2 and last 2 pages of passport + address proof, signed across blank margin in dark blue or black ink.

Check #3

Photographs (Minors Only)

Minors below 4 years require 2 physical passport photos (35x45mm white background); adults are photographed live at counter.

Check #4

Fee Receipt / Active UPI

Online payment receipt (already paid on portal) + carry UPI on phone in case SMS alert service or Tatkal upgrade is needed.

Check #5

Application Receipt & Appointment SMS

Printed ARN appointment receipt with bar code + appointment SMS on phone required for CISF security entry at gate.
